title: CISA-AA23-347A-Ransomware-Response
summary: Original summary of ransomware containment, investigation, and clean recovery actions.
content:
## 1.1 [Immediate] Isolate ransomware-encrypted hosts
Contain affected workstations by disconnecting ransomware-infected endpoints from wired, wireless, and storage networks to limit lateral encryption. Preserve evidence and record the isolation time.

## 1.2 [Immediate] Protect clean backup copies
Disconnect backup systems that are not yet affected and verify that recovery copies are isolated from compromised credentials and networks.

## 2.1 [Investigate] Find the initial foothold and recovery tampering
Review VPN, remote-access, email, and process-execution telemetry. Look for shadow-copy deletion and boot-recovery changes associated with ransomware activity.

## 3.1 [Recover] Rebuild from verified clean images
Re-image affected systems from trusted media and restore only from backups verified to predate the compromise.
